ARIA 无障碍属性（aria-label, aria-describedby, aria-required 等全部持久 ARIA 配置）；3. 键盘导航属性（tabindex）；4. 表现样式属性（class 类名与 style 内联样式）；5. 测试与自定义属性（data-* 属性，如 data-test）；\\n   - 单独重置瞬态与编辑状态：重置 value = 在内存中实例化全新输入元素：const newNode = document.createElement('input')；\\n   - c. 遍历 oldNode.attributes，安全复制 5 类持久属性（label 关联、ARIA、tabindex、class/style、data-*），显式过滤排除 value 与瞬态 aria-invalid；设置 newNode.type = trustedDraft=''）；\\n   - e. 取消防抖定时器：调用 DebounceScheduler.cancel()，销毁活跃定时器并单调递增调度纪元；\\n   - f. 执行物理节点替换：oldNode.replaceWith(newNode)；\\n   - g. 呈现与错误复位：DisplayRenderer.renderPlaceholder(displayElement, nextGeneration。至此事务成功完成。\\n   阶段三：事务异常拦截与原子回滚（Rollback Phase，catch 块保护）：\\n   - 若在阶段二的任何环节（创建/属性复制/事件绑定前失败、replaceWith 抛错、替换后 renderPlaceholder 失败、clearInputError 失败或 focus 失败）发生异常：\\n     * catch JavaScript 伪代码：\\n1. 模块接口签名规范：\\n   - DisplayRenderer:\\n     * renderProjectName(displayElement: HTMLElement, text: string): void\\n     * renderPlaceholder(displayElement: HTMLElement, }\\n   - InputController:\\n     * bindInputNode(node: HTMLInputElement, bornGeneration: number): void\\n     * focusInput(): void\\n   - ResetController:\\n     * captureSnapshot(): init(elements: { displayElement: HTMLElement, initialInputNode: HTMLInputElement, errorContainer: HTMLElement, resetButton: HTMLElement }): void\\n\\n2. 完整自包含 JavaScript 伪代码（DOM 引用显式注入、无 ReferenceError 风险、安全复制 5 类持久属性、newNode 传递物理回插并杜绝空节点残留与旧定时器混入）：\\n```javascript\\n// 客户端运行时纯内存状态\\nlet activeInputNode = null;\\nlet inputGeneration = 1;\\nlet schedulerEpoch = 0;\\nlet pendingTimerId = null;\\n\\n// DOM 元素引用由 AppController.init 显式装配\\nlet displayElement = null;\\nlet errorContainer = null;\\nlet resetButton = null;\\n\\nconst DisplayRenderer = {\\n  renderProjectName(element, placeholderText;\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nconst FeedbackBanner = {\\n  showInputError(inputNode, container, message) {\\n    if (container) {\\n      container.textContent = message;\\n      container.style.display = 'block';\\n    }\\n    if (inputNode) {\\n      inputNode.classList.add('error');\\n      inputNode.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');\\n    }\\n  },\\n  clearInputError(inputNode, container) {\\n    if (container) {\\n      container.textContent = '';\\n      container.style.display = 'none';\\n    }\\n    if (inputNode) {\\n      inputNode.classList.remove('error');\\n      inputNode.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n    }\\n  },\\n  showGlobalError(message) {\\n    console.error('[Global Error]', message);\\n    let banner = 'global-banner';\\n      document.body.prepend(banner);\\n    }\\n    banner.textContent = message;\\n    banner.style.display = 'block';\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nconst ValidatorModule = {\\n  validate(draft) {\\n    if (!draft || typeof draft !== 'string' || draft.trim().length === 0) {\\n      return { isValid: false, errorMessage: '项目名不能为空，请输入有效字符' };\\n    }\\n    return { isValid: true, errorMessage: null };\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nconst DebounceScheduler = {\\n  schedule(draftSnapshot, targetNode, targetGeneration, callback, delayMs = 300) {\\n    if (pendingTimerId !== null) {\\n      clearTimeout(pendingTimerId);\\n      pendingTimerId = null;\\n    }\\n    schedulerEpoch++;\\n    const thisEpoch = schedulerEpoch;\\n    pendingTimerId = setTimeout(() =\\u003e {\\n      pendingTimerId = null;\\n      // 定时器到期四重有效性守卫\\n      if (\\n        thisEpoch !== schedulerEpoch ||\\n        targetGeneration !== inputGeneration ||\\n        targetNode !== activeInputNode ||\\n        !document.body.contains(targetNode)\\n      ) {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      callback(draftSnapshot);\\n    }, delayMs);\\n  },\\n  cancel() {\\n    if (pendingTimerId !== null) {\\n      clearTimeout(pendingTimerId);\\n      pendingTimerId = null;\\n    }\\n    schedulerEpoch++;\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nfunction handleDebouncedValidateAndDisplay(draftSnapshot) {\\n  try {\\n    const res = ValidatorModule.validate(draftSnapshot);\\n    if (!res.isValid) {\\n      DisplayRenderer.renderPlaceholder(displayElement, '【等待输入核对】');\\n      FeedbackBanner.showInputError(activeInputNode, errorContainer, res.errorMessage);\\n    } else {\\n      FeedbackBanner.clearInputError(activeInputNode, errorContainer);\\n      DisplayRenderer.renderProjectName(displayElement, draftSnapshot);\\n    }\\n  } catch (err) {\\n    FeedbackBanner.showGlobalError('系统遇到异常，已为您保留当前输入');\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nfunction createReplacementInputNode(oldNode, generation) {\\n  const newNode = document.createElement('input');\\n  // 安全持久配置复制策略：遍历 oldNode.attributes，安全复制 5 类持久属性，排除瞬态属性和编辑值\\n  const TRANSIENT_ATTRIBUTES = new Set(['value', 'aria-invalid']);\\n  if (oldNode \\u0026\\u0026 oldNode.attributes) {\\n    for (let i = 0; i \\u003c oldNode.attributes.length; i++) {\\n      const attr = oldNode.attributes[i];\\n      if (!TRANSIENT_ATTRIBUTES.has(attr.name.toLowerCase())) {\\n        newNode.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  newNode.type = 'text';\\n  newNode.value = '';\\n  newNode.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n\\n  InputController.bindInputNode(newNode, generation);\\n  return newNode;\\n}\\n\\nconst InputController = {\\n  bindInputNode(node, bornGeneration) {\\n    let isComposing = false;\\n    let trustedDraft = '';\\n\\n    function guard(e) {\\n      if (\\n        e.currentTarget !== node ||\\n        node !== activeInputNode ||\\n        bornGeneration !== inputGeneration ||\\n DebounceScheduler.schedule(trustedDraft, node, bornGeneration, (draft) =\\u003e {\\n        handleDebouncedValidateAndDisplay(draft);\\n      }, 300);\\n    });\\n  },\\n  focusInput() {\\n    if (activeInputNode) {\\n      activeInputNode.focus();\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nconst ResetController = {\\n  captureSnapshot() {\\n    const node = activeInputNode;\\n    return {\\n      activeInputNode: node,\\n      inputGeneration: inputGeneration,\\n      schedulerEpoch: schedulerEpoch,\\n      pendingTimerId: pendingTimerId,\\n      hadPendingTimer: pendingTimerId !== null,\\n      draft: node ? node.value : '',\\n      displayContent: displayElement ? displayElement.textContent : '',\\n      errorContent: errorContainer ? errorContainer.textContent : '',\\n      errorDisplay: errorContainer ? errorContainer.style.display : '',\\n      hasInputError: node ? node.classList.contains('error') : false,\\n      ariaInvalid: node ? node.getAttribute('aria-invalid') : null,\\n      parentNode: node ? node.parentNode : null,\\n      nextSibling: node ? node.nextSibling : null\\n    };\\n  },\\n  rollback(snapshot, err, newNode = null) {\\n    try {\\n      if (!snapshot || !snapshot.activeInputNode) return;\\n      const oldNode = snapshot.activeInputNode;\\n      // 1. 若新节点已挂入 DOM，物理替换回原节点并彻底移除空新节点；若原节点脱离，插入原位置\\n      if (newNode \\u0026\\u0026 newNode.parentNode) {\\n        newNode.parentNode.replaceChild(oldNode, newNode);\\n      } else if (activeInputNode \\u0026\\u0026 activeInputNode !== oldNode \\u0026\\u0026 activeInputNode.parentNode) {\\n        activeInputNode.parentNode.replaceChild(oldNode, activeInputNode);\\n      } else if (snapshot.parentNode \\u0026\\u0026 !document.body.contains(oldNode)) {\\n        snapshot.parentNode.insertBefore(oldNode, snapshot.nextSibling);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 2. 状态原子还原\\n      activeInputNode = oldNode;\\n      inputGeneration = snapshot.inputGeneration;\\n      // 调度纪元严格单调递增，彻底废弃清空期间可能进入事件队列的迟到定时器\\n      schedulerEpoch++;\\n      oldNode.value = snapshot.draft;\\n\\n      // 3. 瞬态校验状态还原\\n      if (snapshot.hasInputError) {\\n        oldNode.classList.add('error');\\n        if (snapshot.ariaInvalid !== null) {\\n          oldNode.setAttribute('aria-invalid', snapshot.ariaInvalid);\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        oldNode.classList.remove('error');\\n        oldNode.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 4. 展示区与错误提示还原\\n      if (displayElement) {\\n        displayElement.textContent = snapshot.displayContent;\\n      }\\n      if (errorContainer) {\\n        errorContainer.textContent = snapshot.errorContent;\\n        errorContainer.style.display = snapshot.errorDisplay;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 5. 调度任务自洽恢复：若原先存在排队任务，以全新纪元重新调度\\n      if (snapshot.hadPendingTimer \\u0026\\u0026 snapshot.draft.trim().length \\u003e 0) {\\n        DebounceScheduler.schedule(snapshot.draft, oldNode, inputGeneration, handleDebouncedValidateAndDisplay, 300);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 6. 光标回焦\\n      try {\\n        InputController.focusInput();\\n      } catch (_) {}\\n\\n      // 7. 可见通知\\n      FeedbackBanner.showGlobalError('清空操作遇到异常，已为您完整恢复当前输入与核对状态');\\n    } catch (rollbackErr) {\\n      // 兜底保护：绝不刷新页面，提供原文复制展示\\n      FeedbackBanner.showGlobalError('清空恢复遇到严重异常。您的草稿文本已安全保留：' + (snapshot ? snapshot.draft : ''));\\n    }\\n  },\\n  handleReset() {\\n    const snapshot = ResetController.captureSnapshot();\\n    let newNode = null;\\n    try {\\n      const oldNode = snapshot.activeInputNode;\\n      const nextGeneration = snapshot.inputGeneration + 1;\\n\\n      // 步骤 1：内存预制新节点并安全复制 5 类持久属性\\n      newNode = createReplacementInputNode(oldNode, nextGeneration);\\n\\n      // 步骤 2：取消防抖定时器并递增调度纪元\\n      DebounceScheduler.cancel();\\n\\n      // 步骤 3：物理替换 DOM 节点\\n      if (oldNode \\u0026\\u0026 oldNode.parentNode) {\\n        oldNode.replaceWith(newNode);\\n      } else {\\n        throw new Error('原输入框已脱离文档树，无法执行物理替换');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 步骤 4：呈现与错误清理\\n      DisplayRenderer.renderPlaceholder(displayElement, '【等待输入核对】');\\n      FeedbackBanner.clearInputError(newNode, errorContainer);\\n\\n      // 步骤 5：焦点回退转移\\n      newNode.focus();\\n\\n      // 步骤 6：事务正式原子提交点（Commit Point）\\n      activeInputNode = newNode;\\n      inputGeneration = nextGeneration;\\n    } catch (err) {\\n      // 任意步骤发生异常，触发全量原子回滚并显式传入 newNode 确保其被替换移除\\n      ResetController.rollback(snapshot, err, newNode);\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nconst AppController = {\\n  init(elements) {\\n    displayElement = elements.displayElement;\\n    errorContainer = elements.errorContainer;\\n    resetButton = elements.resetButton;\\n    activeInputNode = elements.initialInputNode;\\n    inputGeneration = 1;\\n    schedulerEpoch = 0;\\n    pendingTimerId = null;\\n\\n    InputController.bindInputNode(activeInputNode, inputGeneration);\\n    resetButton.addEventListener('click', () =\\u003e {\\n      ResetController.handleReset();\\n    });\\n    DisplayRenderer.renderPlaceholder(displayElement, '【等待输入核对】');\\n
